description: Verifies the uncertain quantity wrapper: nominal value and uncertainty propagation of interval sums, enclosure of interval products, and access to the nominal vector of a zonotope-backed quantity.

checks.label: the nominal value of the sum equals the sum of the nominal values
the uncertainty of the sum equals the sum of the uncertainties
the nominal value of the product lies in the enclosure around 50
the first component of the zonotope centre is preserved
the second component of the zonotope centre is preserved
